questions.question: Which blood group is known as the universal donor?
questions.explanation: O-negative is the universal donor blood group.

questions.question: The Ranji Trophy is associated with which sport?
questions.explanation: The Ranji Trophy is a domestic first-class cricket competition.

questions.question: The Olympic Games are held once every how many years?
questions.explanation: The Summer Olympics are held every 4 years.

questions.question: Which organ in the human body purifies blood?
questions.explanation: The kidneys filter and purify blood.

questions.question: Who gave the slogan "Give me blood and I will give you freedom"?
questions.explanation: The slogan is associated with Subhash Chandra Bose.

questions.question: Which planet is known as the "Red Planet"?
questions.explanation: Mars looks red due to iron oxide on its surface.

questions.question: The Thar Desert is located mainly in which state?
questions.explanation: The Thar Desert lies mostly in Rajasthan.

questions.question: Which day is celebrated as World Environment Day?
questions.explanation: World Environment Day is observed on 5 June.

questions.question: How many bones are there in the adult human body?
questions.explanation: An adult human has 206 bones.

questions.question: Which is the smallest continent by area?
questions.explanation: Australia is the smallest continent.

questions.question: The Tropic of Cancer does NOT pass through which Indian state?
questions.explanation: It passes through 8 states but not Odisha.

questions.question: Which schedule of the Constitution deals with anti-defection?
questions.explanation: The 10th Schedule contains the anti-defection provisions.

questions.question: Which gas is most abundant in the Earth’s atmosphere?
questions.explanation: Nitrogen is about 78% of the atmosphere.

questions.question: World Water Day is observed on:
questions.explanation: World Water Day is observed on 22 March.

questions.question: The Khajuraho temples were built by which dynasty?
questions.explanation: The Chandela dynasty built the Khajuraho temples.

questions.question: Who decides the repo rate in India?
questions.explanation: The RBI sets the repo rate through its Monetary Policy Committee.

questions.question: Which planet has the most moons in the solar system?
questions.explanation: Saturn currently has the most confirmed moons in the solar system.

questions.question: Light travels fastest in:
questions.explanation: Light travels fastest in a vacuum (~3×10⁸ m/s).

questions.question: The "Make in India" initiative was launched in:
questions.explanation: Make in India was launched in September 2014.

questions.question: A train 120 m long crosses a pole in 6 seconds. Find its speed in km/h.
A can do a work in 10 days and B in 15 days. Working together, in how many days will they finish it?
questions.explanation: Combined one-day work = 1/10 + 1/15 = 25/150. Time = 150/25 = 6 days.

questions.question: Find the area of a circle with radius 21 cm. (Use π = 22/7)
Find the value of √625.
After a 25% discount, an item costs ₹450. Find its marked price.
Find 10% of 10% of 200.
A boat travels 36 km downstream in 3 hours. If the speed of the stream is 2 km/h, find the speed of the boat in still water.
questions.explanation: Downstream speed = 36/3 = 12 km/h = boat + stream. Boat = 12 − 2 = 10 km/h.

questions.question: If today is Sunday, what day will it be after 47 days?
questions.explanation: 47 mod 7 = 5; Sunday + 5 = Friday.

questions.question: Which letter is 2nd to the right of the 10th letter from the left in the English alphabet?
questions.explanation: 10th letter = J; 10 + 2 = 12th letter = L.

questions.question: Find the odd pair: (9, 729), (8, 516), (2, 8), (4, 64)
questions.explanation: In each correct pair the second number is the cube of the first. 8³ = 512, not 516.

questions.question: In a row of 56 students, Ravi is 35th from the left. What is his position from the right?
questions.explanation: Position from right = 56 − 35 + 1 = 22.

questions.question: Find the next term: 49, 64, 81, 100, 121, ?
questions.explanation: These are perfect squares 7²…11². Next is 12² = 144.

questions.question: Find the next term: 4, 7, 12, 19, 28, ?
questions.explanation: Differences increase by 2 each step; next difference is 11, so 28 + 11 = 39.

questions.question: If MOON is coded as PRRQ, how is SUN coded?
questions.explanation: Each letter is shifted forward by 3. Applying the same to SUN gives VXQ.

questions.question: What is the angle between the hour and minute hands of a clock at 4:00?
questions.explanation: Each hour mark = 30°. At 4:00 the angle is 4 × 30° = 120°.

questions.question: A person walks 8 km East and then 15 km North. What is the shortest distance from the starting point?
questions.explanation: Shortest distance = √(8² + 15²) = √289 = 17 km.

questions.question: If + means ×, and × means −, then evaluate: 10 + 5 × 4.
questions.explanation: Replace symbols: 10 × 5 − 4 = 50 − 4 = 46.

questions.question: Find the next term: 5, 15, 45, 135, ?
questions.explanation: Each term follows ×3: 135 × 3 = 405.

questions.question: Complete the series: A, E, I, M, ?
questions.explanation: Each letter advances by 4 places, so the next is Q.

questions.question: Find the odd one out: 7, 16, 19, 23
questions.explanation: 19, 23, 7 are prime numbers; 16 is a composite number.

questions.question: Which letter is 2nd from the right end of the English alphabet?
questions.explanation: The 2nd letter from the right is the 25th from the left = Y.
